picks.title: AI infrastructure company Cornelis raises $205M to chip away at Nvidia's dominance
picks.why_it_matters: A $205M raise for AI infrastructure targeting GPU inefficiency signals continued investor appetite for picks-and-shovels plays in the AI stack and validates the thesis that Nvidia's dominance creates opportunities for specialized networking/fabric solutions.

picks.title: Superhuman acquires YC-backed notetaker Fathom as productivity platforms push for agentic work
picks.why_it_matters: A successful YC exit via acquisition shows the consolidation play in AI productivity tools is accelerating, with established platforms acquiring point solutions that have proven user traction (400K MAU) to build agentic workflows.

picks.title: Pion, an agent designed to run any company autonomously
picks.why_it_matters: High HN engagement (419 points, 519 comments) on an autonomous company-running agent indicates strong developer/founder interest in the next wave of AI agents moving from task-level to business-level automation—a space ripe for early-stage investment.
